title: Copies Are Not Confirmations: How News Duplication Fools LLM Judges and Continual Learners
abstract: arXiv:2611.09203v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many news reports of a claim are copies of one source: wire stories, content shared within a media group, syndicated features and press releases. We ask whether LLM judges and continual learners treat such copies as independent confirmations. In 200,000 English CC-News articles, a MinHash detector links 18.9% to a near-copy from another outlet (precision 0.97 once boilerplate is removed); it links 92% of edited reprints to their originals but none of the LLM rewrites by phi4, Llama 3.2 or Gemini 2.5 Flash. Shown three identical reprints of a claim about an unknown person instead of one report, Llama 3.2 3B and phi4 14B raised the share of lies they accepted from 0.06 to 0.71 and from 0.21 to 0.90 and ignored a note that the reports came from one source; Gemini 2.5 Flash already believed a single report, and Gemini 2.5 Pro followed provenance notes and tables. translated_title: 副本不是确认：新闻重复如何欺骗大语言模型评判者与持续学习者
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.09203v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：关于某一主张的许多新闻报道都是同一来源的副本：通讯社稿件、媒体集团内共享的内容、联合特稿和新闻稿。我们探讨LLM评判者和持续学习者是否将此类副本视为独立的确认。在200,000篇英文CC-News文章中，一个MinHash检测器将18.9%的文章与另一媒体机构的近似副本关联起来（去除样板文本后精确率为0.97）；它能将92%的编辑转载与其原文关联，但无法关联phi4、Llama 3.2或Gemini 2.5 Flash生成的LLM改写版本。当向Llama 3.2 3B和phi4 14B展示关于某陌生人的同一主张的三份相同转载而非一份报道时，它们接受的谎言比例分别从0.06上升到0.71和从0.21上升到0.90，并且忽略了报道来自同一来源的提示；Gemini 2.5 Flash已经相信单份报道，而Gemini 2.5 Pro则能遵循来源注释和表格。在模拟的持续学习流中，向评判者展示每个...
tldr: 该研究揭示了新闻重复副本并非独立确认，LLM评判者会被同一来源的重复报道欺骗——如Llama 3.2 3B和phi4 14B在面对三份相同转载时接受谎言的比例从0.06和0.21分别飙升至0.71和0.90——表明去重检测对LLM证据评估至关重要。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that duplicated news copies are not independent confirmations—LLM judges like Llama 3.2 3B and phi4 14B, when shown three identical reprints instead of one, raised the share of lies they accepted from 0.06 to 0.71 and from 0.21 to 0.90—highlighting the critical need for duplicate detection in LLM evidence assessment.
